# DSH 提示词增强器

**简体中文** ｜ [English](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件。在输入框写提示词，点一下按钮，模型改写后替换输入框内容。

- 包名：`@jianyiagi/dsh-prompt-enhancer`
- 仓库：https://github.com/JianYiAG/dsh-prompt-enhancer
- 许可：MIT

---

## 安装

**桌面端**：

1. 左侧栏进「插件」页
2. 安装 bundle，填 `@jianyiagi/dsh-prompt-enhancer`
3. 完全退出应用后重新打开

**CLI / Web 端**：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @jianyiagi/dsh-prompt-enhancer
```

CLI 安装后若未生效，在「插件」页勾选该插件，或把包名加入 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，然后重启应用。

安装与常见问题见 [DISTRIBUTION.md](DISTRIBUTION.md)。

---

## 使用

1. 在输入框输入提示词
2. 点模型选择器左侧的按钮
3. 按钮停止转动后，输入框内容已替换为改写结果；不满意可在输入框内撤销

输入框为空时按钮不显示。

也可输入 `/prompt-enhance 提示词`，结果以命令结果行显示，不写回输入框。

---

## 配置

默认使用当前会话的模型。可在 profile 补丁中指定固定模型：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: prompt-enhancer
      name: '@jianyiagi/dsh-prompt-enhancer'
      config:
        provider: <provider-id>
        model: <model-id>
```

两个字段需同时提供；删除 `config` 即恢复使用会话模型。

---

## 卸载

桌面端在「插件」页卸载；CLI：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove @jianyiagi/dsh-prompt-enhancer
```

---

MIT

plugins.description: Per-workspace persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): sidebar panel, automatic system-prompt injection, and an agent tool to save memories
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-memories

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-workspace-memories?style=flat-square)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-workspace-memories)
[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)

**Per-workspace persistent memory for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH)** — a plugin that gives every workspace its own durable memory files, injects them into every session running in that workspace, and lets both you and the agent manage them.

## Why this plugin exists

DSH agents are stateless across sessions: everything a session "learns" — your project's decisions, conventions, hard-won debugging facts — lives only in that conversation's context and is gone when it ends. The built-in mechanism for durable knowledge is `AGENTS.md`, but it is a static, project-owned instruction file: the agent cannot update it on its own, and **some things should not live in the project folder at all** — server addresses and topologies, local environment quirks, machine-specific paths, personal working conventions. Anything under the project tree risks being committed to git by accident.

This plugin closes that gap with a small, explicit memory loop whose default storage is **outside the project directory**:

1. **Every workspace gets a memory directory** — by default under the DSH data directory (`~/.dsh/workspace-memory/<workspace>/`), never inside the repo. Plain Markdown you can read, diff, and back up. (An opt-in `workspace` storage mode keeps memories in `<workspace>/.dsh/memory/` for teams who *want* them versioned alongside the code.)
2. **Memories are injected automatically** — each session created in a workspace carries that workspace's memory files in its system prompt, alongside `AGENTS.md`, so a fresh session starts already "remembering".
3. **The agent can write memories itself** — a global `save_workspace_memory` tool lets any session persist a decision, server detail, convention, or preference the moment you say "remember this".
4. **You stay in control** — a sidebar panel lists, creates, edits, and deletes memory files per workspace, so memory stays inspectable and correctable instead of hidden in a database.

## Features

| Capability | Where |
|---|---|
| Browse / create / edit / delete memory files | **Workspace Memory** sidebar panel (switch workspaces via the selector) |
| Ask the agent to remember something | Any session: "remember: …" → the agent calls `save_workspace_memory` |
| Automatic recall | Every session in the workspace gets its memory files injected into its system prompt |

Works in every built-in agent preset (Standard, PTC, Minimal, Creator): the tool is registered in the root composition, and global tools are visible to all presets unless a custom preset opts out with a `tools.restrict` allow list — add `save_workspace_memory` to that list if so.

## Installation

The package is plain JavaScript with no build step, so every install channel works:

```sh
# from npm (once published)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-workspace-memories

# straight from GitHub (no build script needed — sources ship as-is)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lengfengng-tech/dsh-workspace-memories

# from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-workspace-memories
```

Or use the GUI: sidebar **Plugins → Add plugin**, paste a package name, GitHub address, or absolute local path, then **Enable now**.

Uninstall: the Plugins page, or `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-workspace-memories`.

## Usage

- Open the **Workspace Memory** entry in the sidebar. The selector defaults to the workspace of the current session. **New file** creates a `.md` memory (the extension is added when missing); select a file to edit, save, or delete it.
- Tell the agent "remember: this project uses pnpm, not npm" — it writes a memory file that every session of the workspace (and the panel) sees immediately.
- Storage and layout are configurable: `storage: home` (default, DSH data directory, outside the project) or `storage: workspace` (inside the project at `directory`, default `.dsh/memory`).

## Important: start a new session after installing or upgrading

Tool registration takes effect immediately on the host, but **a model's visible tool list is assembled when each conversation turn starts**:

- If a session's current turn began *before* the plugin was installed or reloaded, that turn's tool declaration is stale. This is most visible in **PTC mode**, where the model reads a pre-generated TypeScript binding (`ToolArgsMap`) that does not yet contain `save_workspace_memory` — the model may conclude "there is no memory tool", or fall back to probing the tool by name through the code channel (which actually works, since dispatch goes through the live host registry).
- **The fix is simple: start a new session, or just send a new message after the current turn ends.** The next turn regenerates the tool declaration and `save_workspace_memory` appears normally — no probing needed.

Memory injection into the system prompt is attached when an agent is created (session start, resume after a restart, clear, or compaction); once attached, a session picks up changed memory files on its next step automatically.

## Data layout and safety

Two storage modes, chosen by the plugin's `storage` config:

| Mode | Memory location | Use it for |
|---|---|---|
| `home` (default) | `~/.dsh/workspace-memory/<workspace-key>/` — outside the project | Machine-local or sensitive notes: server configs, environment quirks, personal conventions |
| `workspace` | `<workspace>/.dsh/memory/` — inside the project | Team-shared memories meant to be committed alongside the code |

```
~/.dsh/workspace-memory/     # default memory store, one subdirectory per workspace
dsh-workspace-memories/        # this plugin
├── package.json             #   bundle manifest (dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client)
├── cordis.patch.yml         #   plugin row declaration
├── index.js                 #   host: /api routes + prompt injection + the save tool
├── client.js                #   browser: sidebar entry + management panel
├── locale/                  #   panel copy (en, zh)
├── icon.svg
└── selftest.mjs             #   host-logic self-test: node selftest.mjs
```

Safety constraints: the browser panel can only address registered workspaces by `workspaceId` (no arbitrary host paths); file names are strictly validated (no path separators, `..`, whitespace, or control characters); one file is capped at 1 MiB; prompt injection truncates each file to 32K characters and caps at 20 files.

## Development

- Install with a `link:` dependency (local-path install does this): editing `client.js` hot-reloads in the page via the client HMR receiver; editing `index.js` (host code) requires a DSH restart to load the new module generation.
- Run the self-test: `node selftest.mjs` (mocks the plugin context; covers routes, prompt rendering, tool writes, and validation failures).
- Runtime checks: host entry `include:workspace-memory` should be `active`; the client slot `sidebar.panellist` should list a `workspace-memory` occupant; `save_workspace_memory` should appear in the tool list.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) — © 2026 lengfengng-tech

---

This is a community plugin built on [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness); it is not an official DeepSeek product. Naming follows the [DSH brand guidelines](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/BRAND_GUIDELINES.md).

plugins.description: MCP Master for DeepSeek Harness: per-session MCP server picker with global and project (.mcp.json) catalogs, OAuth sign-in, and trust review
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-master

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**MCP Master for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).** Choose which MCP servers each session uses — from your **global** list and the workspace's **project** list — with a picker that sits right before the composer's model selector. Pick them when a session starts, and switch them at any time afterwards, just like the model.

- **Project servers** come from the files other agents already use: `.mcp.json` (Claude Code), `.cursor/mcp.json`, `.vscode/mcp.json`, `.dsh/mcp.json`.
- **Global servers** come from `~/.dsh/mcp-master/mcp.json` (same `mcpServers` format). A project server shadows a global one of the same name.

```json
// <workspace>/.mcp.json  or  ~/.dsh/mcp-master/mcp.json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "orion-mcp":            { "command": "uv", "args": ["run", "--project", ".", "orion-mcp"] },
    "atlassian-mcp-server": { "type": "http", "url": "https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp/authv2" },
    "conduktor-console":    { "command": "npx", "args": ["mcp-remote", "https://…/api/mcp", "--header", "Authorization: Bearer ${CONDUKTOR_API_TOKEN}"], "enabled": false }
  }
}
```

## The picker

`[ 🔌 MCP 2 ● ]  [ model ▾ ]  [ ➤ ]` — in the composer row of every session, including a brand-new one.

- **Zero footprint when unused**: no global or project servers → nothing renders.
- **Chip**: number of servers active in this session and one status dot for them (green connected · amber sign-in needed · red failing · pulsing starting). A small blue dot means project servers await review.
- **Panel** (click the chip; Esc / click outside to close): *Project* and *Global* groups. Each row has a **checkbox = use in this session**, status, transport, a `default` tag, and inline **Sign in** / **Retry**. Expand a row for the command/URL (as written — never variable-expanded), auth, server version, tools, logs, Reconnect, Sign out, Revoke trust.
- **Footer**: what new sessions start with, and **Use for new sessions** to save the current selection as this workspace's default (**Reset** returns to the files' own `enabled` flags).
- Theme tokens only (light/dark follow the app); copy follows **Settings → General → Language**.

## How sessions get servers

| Topic | Behavior |
|---|---|
| New session | Starts from the workspace default: the saved one, or else every trusted server whose file entry is not `"enabled": false` / `"disabled": true`. |
| Forks & subagents | Inherit the parent session's selection (`parentSession`). |
| Switching later | Checking/unchecking registers/unregisters that server's tools in **this session only**, from the next step on. DSH itself records tool additions/removals in the session log (`developer/message` tool-addition/removal), so history, resume, and replay stay consistent — unlike an agent preset, which is a whole plugin composition and therefore locked once the session starts. |
| Persistence | Selections, defaults, trust, and OAuth tokens live in `~/.dsh/mcp-master/state.json` (0600). Config files are never modified. |
| Process lifetime | A server runs while a live session — or a session open in the UI but not started yet — selects it; it stops 2 minutes after the last one deselects it, and a workspace with no sessions or viewers shuts down after 15 idle minutes. |

## Trust (project servers)

A `.mcp.json` in a cloned repository can run any command, so project servers must be **trusted** before they run (same model as Claude Code's project-server approval). Checking an untrusted server shows the exact command/URL with **Trust & use**. Trust is per workspace and bound to the entry as written: if the command, args, env, URL, or headers change, the server becomes **Changed** and needs review again. Global servers are yours and always trusted. `autoTrust: true` skips the review.

## Transports and auth

- **stdio** (own process group, reaped with its children; cwd = workspace root), **Streamable HTTP** (session ids, SSE responses, `list_changed` stream), **legacy HTTP+SSE** (automatic fallback). Server→client `ping` / `roots/list` are answered.
- **OAuth** per the MCP authorization spec: RFC 9728 → RFC 8414/OIDC discovery → RFC 7591 dynamic client registration → authorization code + PKCE (S256) with RFC 8707 `resource`, then refresh. Tokens are keyed by server URL, so one sign-in covers every workspace. An explicit `Authorization` header is used as-is; `"oauth": { "clientId", "clientSecret", "scope" }` covers providers without dynamic registration.
- **Variables**: `${VAR}`, `${VAR:-default}`, `${env:VAR}`, `${workspaceFolder}` — resolved from DSH's environment layered over your login-shell environment (so `~/.zshrc` exports and your shell `PATH` work in the desktop app).
- **Tools** are named `mcp__<server>__<tool>` like the built-in MCP client; input schemas are folded into the registry's JSON-Schema subset (`$ref`, nullable `anyOf`, type arrays, `allOf`; dropped constraints become description hints); `readOnlyHint` tools may run in parallel.

## Configuration (optional)

```yaml
# your profile's cordis.patch.yml
- id: mcp-master
  name: dsh-mcp-master
  config:
    globalConfigFile: ~/.dsh/mcp-master/mcp.json   # false disables the global scope
    configFiles: [.mcp.json, .cursor/mcp.json, .vscode/mcp.json, .dsh/mcp.json]
    autoTrust: false
    searchParents: true          # also look in parent directories of the session cwd
    startupWaitMs: 5000          # a new session waits this long for selected servers that are still starting
    connectTimeoutMs: 60000
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 300000
    idleShutdownMinutes: 15
```

## Security notes

- `/mcp-master/api/*` passes DSH's connection fence (Host/Origin + browser authentication); mutating calls also need a custom header that cross-origin pages cannot send without a CORS preflight; paths must be inside registered workspaces or live session directories.
- The OAuth redirect (`/mcp-master/oauth/callback`) opens in your system browser without the DSH cookie and is authorized by a single-use 192-bit `state`.
- Logs and the UI redact codes, tokens, and `Bearer` values; command lines are shown unexpanded. `state.json` holds tokens — treat it like a credentials file.

## Develop

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run verify          # build + typecheck + tests (node --test runs the .ts tests directly)
```

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | Host entry: options, agent lifecycle hooks, route mounting |
| `src/host/config.ts` | Catalog discovery (project + global), dialects, variable expansion, fingerprints |
| `src/host/runtime.ts` | Trust, defaults, per-session selections, server lifecycle, per-agent tool registration |
| `src/host/state.ts` | Persistent state (`~/.dsh/mcp-master/state.json`) |
| `src/host/stdio.ts`, `http.ts`, `jsonrpc.ts` | MCP transports and JSON-RPC plumbing (zero runtime dependencies) |
| `src/host/oauth.ts` | MCP authorization (discovery, DCR, PKCE, refresh) |
| `src/host/schema.ts`, `tools.ts` | Schema folding and ToolDefinitions |
| `src/host/api.ts` | HTTP API + OAuth callback |
| `src/client/*` | Composer picker (React; `__ModuleLoader__` bundle; portal popover like the model menu) |
| `src/shared/types.ts` | Wire contract between the halves |

After rebuilding an installed copy, restart DSH: the Host module is an ES module and is not re-imported in place.

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# DeepSeek-Harness-Plugins

面向 AI Agent 桌面端的 Windows 插件集合。支持两种宿主形态：

- **OpenCode v2**（`~/.config/opencode/plugins/`，配置目录热加载）
- **DeepSeek Harness / dsh**（profile 配置层或 `--patch` 覆盖层）

所有插件均为**纯文件型**、无 npm/pip 依赖：`windows-tools` 依赖系统自带的 PowerShell 5.1；`archivist` 直接运行在宿主内置的 Node/TS 运行时上。

**注意：「复制文件即可安装」只对 OpenCode 端成立。** dsh 端的插件是 ESM 源码、会在运行时导入宿主包（如 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`），因此必须放进 dsh 源码仓库中**已铺好 `node_modules` 的那一层**——惯例位置是 `<dsh-repo>/scratch-plugin/src/`——再把 profile 或 `--patch` 覆盖层指向该副本。指向本仓库的克隆目录会以 `Cannot find module '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'` 失败。

## 插件目录

| 插件 | 能力 | 适用端 |
|---|---|---|
| [windows-tools](windows-tools/README.md) | Windows 桌面观察与自动化，**严格后台模式**（不移动光标、不注入前台键鼠、不请求前台）：状态/元素快照、元素定位与文本读取、**后台窗口截图（自带保留策略）**、后台点击与输入（含按元素点击与写入的策略上报）、后台滚轮与快捷键、窗口状态操作、进程枚举、剪贴板、条件等待（dsh 14 个 / OpenCode 13 个工具；启动程序与激活窗口不提供） | OpenCode v2 + dsh |
| [archivist](archivist/README.md) | 本地长期知识库：资料/对话编译成互链 markdown wiki（检索、校验、索引、日志、免 git 备份，**实测支持千万 token 级数据量**），含双端「对话蒸馏」钩子（13 工具 + 2 钩子） | OpenCode v2 + dsh |

## 给 AI Agent：如何从此仓库安装插件

> 如果你是收到"从这个地址安装插件"指令的 AI，请严格按以下流程执行。

1. 克隆仓库（或下载 zip 解压）到本机任意目录，记其绝对路径为 `$REPO`：
   ```powershell
   git clone https://github.com/changli7047/DeepSeek-Harness-Plugins "$env:USERPROFILE\DeepSeek-Harness-Plugins"
   ```
2. 打开目标插件目录下的 `README.md`，找到其中的 **「AI 安装」** 小节，严格按步骤执行。
3. 执行该 README 中的 **「自检」** 命令，确认输出符合预期后，才算安装成功。
4. 不要跳过平台检查：所有插件目前**仅支持 Windows 10/11**。
5. **dsh 端特别注意**：插件文件必须放进 dsh 源码仓库里已铺好 `node_modules` 的那一层（惯例 `<dsh-repo>/scratch-plugin/src/`），profile 补丁或 `--patch` 的 `name:` 指向**该副本**。指向本仓库的克隆目录会以 `Cannot find module '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'` 失败——插件是 ESM 源码，裸导入按文件位置向上解析。

### For AI agents (English quick steps)

1. `git clone https://github.com/changli7047/DeepSeek-Harness-Plugins` and note the absolute path as `$REPO`.
2. Open `<plugin>/README.md` and follow its **"AI install"** section exactly.
3. Run the **self-test** command from that README; verify the output before reporting success.
4. Windows 10/11 only. No npm/pip dependencies; PowerShell 5.1 ships with the OS.

## 环境要求

- Windows 10 / 11（x64）——`archivist` 为文件类插件，理论可跨平台，当前在 Windows 实测
- 宿主运行时：OpenCode v2 或源码运行的 dsh（两者自带 Node/TS 运行时，`archivist` 依赖它）
- Windows PowerShell 5.1（`windows-tools` 依赖；系统自带，无需安装）
- 无网络依赖（安装后插件不访问网络）

## 安全须知

这些插件拥有**完整的桌面控制能力**（`windows-tools`：截屏、读取窗口内容、向指定窗口投递输入消息、窗口状态操作、剪贴板读写；**严格后台模式，不移动光标也不注入前台键鼠**）。仅在你信任的 Agent 会话中安装；插件本身不包含审批门禁，是否拦截工具调用由宿主（OpenCode/dsh）的权限策略决定。`archivist` 属文件类插件：只读写你指定的知识库目录与状态文件，不模拟输入、不访问网络。

## 新增插件约定（未来扩展）

1. 每个插件一个**顶级目录**：`<plugin-name>/`
2. 目录内必须有 `README.md`，且至少包含四节：
   - 功能与工具清单
   - **AI 安装**（逐条命令、可直接执行）
   - **自检**（可验证安装成功的命令与预期输出）
   - 限制与卸载
3. 在根 README 的「插件目录」表格中登记一行。
4. 发布物为**预构建产物**；如插件有构建步骤，把构建脚本放进插件目录并写明重生成方法。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web 插件：输入框旁常驻显示 DeepSeek API 余额；悬停展开左栏账户余额、右栏本次对话消耗（缓存命中/未命中/输出分档，峰谷自动判断），胶囊右半滑出可充值。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-api-balance

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2f855a?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0969da?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4f46e5?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
![no build step](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-none%20%C2%B7%20source%20only-6b7280?style=flat-square)
![no dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-6b7280?style=flat-square)

<!-- README-I18N:START -->

**中文** | [English](./README.en.md)

<!-- README-I18N:END -->

在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面里显示 DeepSeek API 余额，顺便算一下当前这条对话花了多少钱。

![示意图：输入框旁的余额胶囊，悬停展开余额与消耗两栏](assets/preview.svg)

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-api-balance@1.0.5
```

版本号建议钉死，升级时手动改。DSH 升级、或者这个仓库更新，都不会顺手把你装的插件换掉，这点是故意的。

npm 连不上就从 Release 装，同一个文件：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Charaaah/dsh-web-api-balance/releases/download/v1.0.5/dsh-web-api-balance-1.0.5.tgz
```

从源码装也可以。`dsh plugin` 认仓库 URL 和 `github:owner/repo` 简写（会先探一次 GitHub 连通性），
`#` 后面会被 pnpm 当 git ref，所以能钉到 commit：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Charaaah/dsh-web-api-balance
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Charaaah/dsh-web-api-balance#<commit-sha>
```

装完刷一下页面。如果你之前用 `link:` 或 `file:` 装过同一个版本号，直接 `add` 不会替换它，pnpm 会认为
版本已满足然后跳过，得先 remove。

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-api-balance
```

这条是转发给 profile 目录里的 pnpm，所以会卸掉包和 `package.json` 里那行依赖。`dsh.profile.bundles`
不会跟着清。那是 DSH 的字段，pnpm 不认识，得自己编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` 把包名删掉：

```jsonc
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
  "dshmarket"
  // 删掉这行："dsh-web-api-balance"
] } }
```

留着会指向一个不存在的包，启动时会报。市场页面的插件开关会帮你把这两步一起做，命令行不会。

下面几样卸载不管，需要的话自己清：

- `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 里的 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。这是 DSH 凭证服务的条目，「设置 → 模型」写进去的
  也是同一个，你可能在别处还在用，所以插件不动它。
- profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里手工写的那段 `- id: dsh-web-api-balance`。包没了以后这行会被忽略，
  但里面可能写着 `apiKey`。
- `localStorage` 的 `dsh-web-api-balance:last`，存的是金额和时间戳，没有凭证。

npm 上的版本删不掉（版本号不可变），所以卸载只影响本机，想装回来随时 `add` 一次就行。

## 界面

只有一处 UI：输入框工具栏、发送键左边的常驻胶囊，显示总余额。鼠标移上去（或者键盘聚焦）弹出浮层，
左右两栏，中间一条竖线：

```
总余额      ¥15.00  │   本次对话消耗     梁文谷
充值余额    ¥13.50  │   缓存命中    1,000,000   ¥0.30
赠送余额     ¥1.50  │   缓存未命中  2,000,000   ¥18.00
更新时间    20:00:00│   输出          500,000   ¥13.50
来源        DeepSeek 账号│   ────────────────────────────
                    │   合计                    ¥31.80
```

左栏是账户余额，右栏是这条会话的消耗。没有用量报告时右栏和竖线一起消失，只剩单栏。两栏顶部对齐，
账户栏不必重复胶囊上已经有的名字，也没单独再打一遍总额，总额就是「总余额」那行。

胶囊本身切成两半，没有额外按钮也没有文字：

- 左半边是圆点加金额，点一下立即刷新。
- 右半边是一条 22px 的竖条加钱包加号图标，平时宽度 0、完全看不见，鼠标进胶囊才滑出来，点击在新标签页
  打开充值页。

静止状态下它就是个干净的数字。取不到余额时也没有金额可充，整个右半边不渲染，胶囊变红，浮层里写明
原因。

充值地址优先用账号服务给的 `AccountView.links.topUpUrl`，这样指向内部 Platform 的部署会跳自己的站点；
拿不到就用公开的 `https://platform.deepseek.com/top_up`。浏览器半侧内置了同一个兜底，宿主没报告
地址时右半边也能用。

余额走 DeepSeek 官方的 `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`，登录了账号时走 DSH 自己的账号服务。

## 消耗怎么算的

官方的 token 计数看不出花了多少钱，右栏就把这条会话的累计用量按人民币拆开，三个计费桶各一行：

| 行 | 取数 |
|---|---|
| 缓存命中 | `tokenUsage.cacheReadTokens` |
| 缓存未命中 | `tokenUsage.uncachedInputTokens` + `cacheWriteTokens` |
| 输出 | `tokenUsage.outputTokens` |
| 合计 | 上面三项之和 |

官方 schema 里 `prompt_tokens = prompt_cache_hit_tokens + prompt_cache_miss_tokens`，这三行能覆盖全部
计费 token。缓存本身不额外收费，落盘、存储、过期都不进账单，只有 token 按这三档计价。

用量是宿主从整条会话日志折出来的官方回报值，价格则按 `useProjection('modelSelection')` 里的当前路由查表。
两个投影都是宿主推的，有回报就更新，不用额外请求，也不往外发数据。

价格表是写死的，在 `client.js` 的 `PRICING` 里，单位元每百万 tokens。官方调价了改这一个对象。表里没有的
模型不猜，照样显示 token 数，金额位置写「未收录该模型价格」。旧名字 `deepseek-v4-flash` 和
`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` 按官方说明归到 `deepseek-flash`。

峰谷这块容易看错，多说两句。右栏标题右边那个名字就是当前档位：北京时间工作日 9:00–12:00 和 14:00–18:00
显示「梁文峰」，其余时间「梁文谷」，后者半价。判断是拿当前时刻先算成 UTC+8 再读时钟，浏览器在哪个
时区都一样。

两个已知的坑：一是我没做节假日，插件不带日历，法定假日的工作日会显示梁文峰、把价格算高。二是累计用量里
没有每次请求的时间戳，跨了峰谷的会话没法归到某一档，这个名字的意思只是「此刻发请求按哪档价」。

另外，flash 和 pro 不是一个价。单价从 modelSelection 投影的当前路由查，表里两套价分开（命中 ¥0.04 / ¥0.30，
未命中 ¥2 / ¥9，输出 ¥8 / ¥27，都是高峰价）。路由带不带 `deepseek-official/` 前缀都能对上。`next` 优先于
`lastUsed`，你刚在模型选择器里改过、下次请求才用的那个，显示的就是它。

数字是当前会话的累计，不含子代理（它们各自是独立会话），也不是账号的历史账单。要看账号侧的消耗去官方
平台的用量页。

还有一点：累计用量是一条会话一个总数，里面没记哪段用了哪个模型。一条会话中途从 flash 换成 pro，
整条会按当前模型的单价算。换过就是估值，没换过就是准的。会话切换时组件会重挂，用量是按每条会话的
日志分别折的，不会串。

## 凭证

一般不用填。宿主按这个顺序取，两条路都不用你手输：

1. 账号授权（`deepseekAccount.getBalance`）。就是「设置 → 账号」登录 DeepSeek 之后写入的那个 OAuth 授权，
   这条路上没有 API Key。
2. 已保存的 API Key。`config.apiKey` 优先，留空就去凭证服务里找 `config.apiKeyEnv` 指定的引用，默认
   `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。这跟「设置 → 模型」填 DeepSeek key 时写进 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 的是同一个
   条目，早就配过 key 的话直接就能读；启动 dsh 的进程环境里有同名变量也行。

两条都没有时胶囊显示「余额不可用」，浮层写具体原因，不会静默失败。浮层底部会标这次数字来自哪条路。

宿主半侧为什么必须有：余额接口不带 CORS 头，而且 API Key 不能进浏览器。`host.js` 因此拿着凭证发请求、
缓存结果，在 `/plugins/dsh-web-api-balance/balance` 上出一份 JSON（`?refresh=1` 强制实时查），`client.js`
只 fetch 这个同源路由。路由和页面其它请求走同一套会话令牌鉴权。

## 配置

写在 web profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `id: dsh-web-api-balance` 那行。不配也能用：

```yaml
- id: dsh-web-api-balance
  disabled: false
  inject: [webServer]
  config:
    apiKey: ''                       # 单独指定 key 时填 sk-...（优先级最高）
    apiKeyEnv: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY      # 否则用这个凭证引用 / 环境变量名
    baseURL: https://api.deepseek.com
    refreshSeconds: 300              # 缓存窗口，30-86400 秒
```

顺序是账号授权 → `config.apiKey` → 凭证服务的 `apiKeyEnv` → 同名环境变量，谁先命中用谁。

## 行为和边界

宿主按 `refreshSeconds` 缓存，并发的读共用一次上游调用。账号授权那条走 DSH 自己的服务、不发外部 HTTP；
未登录（返回 `null`）时落到 API Key 那条。浏览器每 5 分钟自动刷一次，点胶囊立即刷。最近一次成功的摘要
存进 `localStorage`，页面刷新先显示旧值再更新。上游返 401/403 归为「key 无效」，不反复重试。

浮层只在悬停或聚焦时渲染，平时不占位，设了 `pointer-events: none` 不会挡住点击。「本次对话消耗」那栏
只在宿主报告过用量之后出现，新会话什么都没发时整栏连同竖线都不渲染。金额留两位小数，不够一分的留三位，
免得显示成 `¥0.00`。样式只用宿主主题令牌（`--dsw-alias-*`），浅色深色都跟随。

路由返回的 JSON 就是浏览器半侧渲染用的：

```jsonc
{
  "ok": true,
  "source": "account" | "api-key",  // 这次数字来自哪条凭证路
  "topUpUrl": "https://platform.deepseek.com/top_up",
  "available": true,                 // 上游 is_available；false 表示余额已耗尽
  "total": 15, "toppedUp": 13.5, "granted": 1.5,
  "currency": "CNY",
  "checkedAt": 1791587145212
}
// 失败时：{ "ok": false, "reason": "...", "message": "...", "checkedAt": ... }
```

## 隐私

包里没有凭证，也不往任何地方回传数据。代码里没有 API Key 字面量，key 只在运行时从插件配置、凭证服务
（`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`，DSH 自己维护）或启动进程的环境变量里读。它唯一的去处是 `Authorization:
Bearer` 头，目标就是余额接口本身（默认 `api.deepseek.com`），没有遥测、没有日志打印、没有第三方请求。
key 也不进浏览器，浏览器半侧只读同源路由返回的几个数字，唯一写本地的是 `localStorage` 里的余额摘要。

打包出来 14 个文件（`LICENSE`、`README.md`、`README.en.md`、`client.js`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`host.js`、
`icon.svg`、`index.js`、`locale/{en,zh}.json`、`package.json`、`release.json`、`assets/preview{,.en}.svg`），
两个测试脚本、构建脚本、任何 profile 状态和任何凭证都不在里面。Release 上的 tarball 和 npm 上的是同一条
`npm pack` 命令打出来的，两条安装路径装到的是同一份字节。

## 开发

两个脚本，只依赖 Node 标准库，不需要 profile 的 node_modules：

```sh
node smoke-test.mjs   # 浏览器半侧
node host-test.mjs    # 宿主半侧
```

`smoke-test.mjs` 用桩模块加载器和带状态的 React 垫片加载 `client.js`，验槽位注册和字典解析，驱动胶囊走
「失败 → 悬停展开 → 点击刷新成功 → 明细齐全」，另外验右半边在无余额时不渲染、有余额时点击用正确的 URL
新开标签页、宿主没给地址时的兜底，以及消耗栏：没有用量时不渲染、三个桶的 token 数与金额逐项对上
`deepseek-v4-pro` 高峰价、合计正确、未知模型只报 token 不报金额、旧模型名走别名价。

`host-test.mjs` 起一个假的 DeepSeek `/user/balance`，把插件的路由挂到真实 HTTP 上跑通缓存命中、强制刷新、
401、环境变量回退、无凭证、账号授权优先、未登录回退到已存 key，以及充值地址。

发布脚本在 `publish/` 下，也不随包发布。这台机器没有 git，所以推仓库是走 GitHub REST API 的
blob → tree → commit → ref 四步，最后读回来校验：

```powershell
node publish/build-repo.mjs --owner Charaaah   # 生成 publish/repo/，补公开元数据和 release.json
node publish/pack-npm.mjs                      # npm pack --ignore-scripts，产物即发 npm 的那份
$env:DSH_GH_TOKEN = '<token>'                  # 只在当前会话里，不落盘
node publish/push-github.mjs --dry-run         # 先看计划
node publish/push-github.mjs
node publish/release-github.mjs                # 打 tag、建 Release、挂 tarball
$env:NPM_TOKEN = '<token>'
node publish/publish-npm.mjs                   # 发的是已打包好的那一份
```

plugins.description: Side-by-side session grid for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: click sessions in the sidebar, get an equal-cell grid of live conversations (max 3 per row), drag the top-right handle to reorder, each pane keeps its own composer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-multi-chat

**Side-by-side sessions for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, as an equal-cell grid.**
Click a session in the left sidebar and it joins the conversation area as its own pane: one
click → one session, three clicks → three sessions. At most **three panes per row**; the grid
degrades to two or one column when the window is narrow. The session you clicked (the shell's
current session) stays highlighted, every pane keeps its own bottom-pinned input box, and panes
can be reordered by dragging the **⠿ handle in the top-right corner** of a pane header.

中文说明：[README.zh.md](README.zh.md) · 设计依据：[docs/design.md](docs/design.md) ·
Design notes (EN): [docs/design.en.md](docs/design.en.md)

---

## What it does

| | |
|---|---|
| **Follow the sidebar** | Every session you click in the sidebar becomes a pane. The pane order survives a page reload. |
| **Equal-cell grid** | At most three equal cells per row (`3 × 3` = 9 panes max, six by default). Rows share the height but never below a comfortable pane height (~420 px); beyond that the grid scrolls. Narrow windows degrade 3 → 2 → 1 columns. |
| **Highlight** | The current session's pane is ringed, its title emphasized, and its sequence badge inverts. |
| **Focus by click** | Clicking inside a non-active pane asks the shell to make that session current (the official sidebar highlight follows). |
| **Reorder by drag** | Grab the ⠿ handle at the top-right of a pane header (immediate drag) or press the header itself (4 px of travel, or a 300 ms hold on touch). Drop on another pane to **swap** the two, drop on empty grid space to move the pane to the end, `Esc` cancels. The dragged pane follows the pointer as a ghost card and the drop target is outlined. |
| **Reorder by keyboard** | The handle is focusable: `Ctrl/⌘ + arrows` swaps with the neighbouring cell (grid-aware for up/down), otherwise nothing happens. |
| **Close** | Each pane has a close control. The active pane can only be closed by handing the shell over to a sibling — otherwise the control is disabled with a reason. The toolbar's **Keep only active** collapses the grid. |
| **Sidebar toggle** | Each session row gets an extra action button (next to archive/pin) that adds/removes that session as a pane **without** navigating. |
| **Degrade, never break** | A single pane → the official single-session UI is used untouched. Unknown/closed sessions render a note card. A crashed pane is contained by a pane-level error boundary. No `slots`/`sessions` service → the plugin stays inert instead of failing the web boot. |

## Install

The package is a DSH bundle plugin: the host half (`.` → `lib/index.js`) only exists so the
package becomes a loader entry; the browser half (`./client` → `lib/client.js`) is what the web
shell loads through the `dsh.client` declaration.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<path-to-this-package>
# then restart the desktop app / profile (bundle layers apply at boot)
```

Read-only check that the row composes (writes nothing):

```powershell
dsh --profile desktop --dump-config | Select-String dsh-multi-chat
```

Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-multi-chat`.

## Development

```powershell
npm install    # dev-only: react, react-dom, jsdom, yaml, @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots
npm test       # 7 suites, 90 tests
npm run typecheck
```

**v0.3.0 feature — the grid can be switched off**: pick **Settings → Plugins → dsh-multi-chat** and flip
*Enable the side-by-side grid* (or press **Exit grid** in the grid toolbar). Off returns the conversation area to
the official single-session view; the panes you had opened are remembered, so switching back on brings the grid
straight back. The preference is stored separately from the pane order, so toggling can never disturb it.

**v0.2.6 fix**: the official turn navigator (the tick rail with turn previews on the right of a
conversation) hid itself inside every pane, because the official stylesheet hides it whenever its
conversation container is narrower than 900px. One pane-scoped rule with higher specificity restores it
(the official class prefix is read from the official stylesheet at runtime, and nothing is injected when
that stylesheet is missing). Verified live: the rail renders 28×102px with its marks inside a 456px pane.

**v0.2.5 fix**: the column count was hard-coded to three, so two sessions left a third of the row empty.
The grid now fills: columns follow the available width (`auto-fit` collapses the tracks no pane lands in),
two panes share the row, and three across appears only when the width allows — panes stay at least ~400px
wide. Measured at a 1680px window: two panes = 2×688px (100% of the row), three = 3×456px, four = 3+1
equal cells.

**v0.2.4 change**: the grid is a wide-window feature, so a narrow window keeps the official single
session view. Below 720px of window width the plugin is completely inert — no session is retained, no
slot is replaced, and nothing is written to the shared storage (which the floating session window would
otherwise clobber with its own pane set). Widening the window brings the grid back; narrowing hands the
conversation area back. Verified live: 490×640 cold start shows the normal conversation, 1680×1050 shows
the grid, resizing switches both ways.

**v0.2.3 fix**: in a narrow window (the ~490 px floating session window) the grid toolbar wrapped into
three lines and squeezed the conversation. It now never wraps and degrades by width — dropping the drag
hint, then the usage counter, swapping the title for a compact "N panes" label — and the row height
yields to short windows (`min(420px, 62vh)`). Measured in a 490×640 window: one 37 px line, single
column, composer fully visible.

**v0.2.2 fixes** (reported from a live session, located in a real browser): the grid used to be
registered in a *session-scoped* slot, which the renderer remounts whenever the shell switches
session — so every switch rebuilt the grid and all pane conversations (the lag that grew with the
number of panes) and replaced the composer input mid-click (the "needs a second click to focus"
bug). The grid now lives in the **root-scope `main` / `conversation` panel cell** (same replacement
semantics, no remount), and pane activation runs on `focusin`/`click` instead of `pointerdown`.
Measured live: one click focuses the composer, session switching ≈ one frame, 5 panes ≈ 2.6k DOM
nodes with off-screen panes virtualised. Details: [docs/design.md](docs/design.md) §4.9.

**v0.2.1 fixes**: switching a session no longer walks a `retain` → publish → `retain` recursion (it
used to overflow the stack, slow every switch down and leave the pane ring and the sidebar highlight
disagreeing); dragging can no longer strand a ghost or a drop ring when the pointer is released
outside the grid; the selection ring is a single crisp outer ring instead of a double-drawn edge.
Details and the reproduction evidence: [docs/design.md](docs/design.md) §4.8.

| Suite | Covers |
|---|---|
| `tests/manifest.test.mjs` | package/bundle/client-half/patch/locale contract, plus "the composer fix stays in place" |
| `tests/host.test.mjs` | the inert host half never throws |
| `tests/store.test.mjs` | pane ledger: follow adds panes, ceiling 6/9, eviction, highlight, `swap`/`moveToEnd`, persistence + the v1→v2 migration, untrusted payloads, drop targeting, keyboard steps |
| `tests/registration.test.mjs` | activation contract: no registration for one pane, shadow registration for 2+, retention/release, sidebar button, unknown sessions, disposal, missing services |
| `tests/real-slot-core.test.mjs` | the same wiring driven through the **real** `SlotCore` shipped by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots` |
| `tests/render.test.mjs` | structural rendering: equal-cell grid, single highlight, handle + close per header, `variant: 'embedded'` for the conversation body, hero/settling phases, token-only stylesheet |
| `tests/interaction.test.mjs` | React DOM in jsdom: pointer drag → swap, drop on empty → move to end, `Esc` cancel, header 4 px threshold, `Ctrl+Arrow` keyboard swap, close/focus, sidebar toggle, toolbar, pane-level crash containment |

plugins.description: A Restart button for DeepSeek Harness Settings: replaces the dsh web process serving the page, then reconnects the page by itself.
plugins.readme_text: **A Restart card in DeepSeek Harness Settings.** One click replaces the `dsh web` process that is serving your page — and the page reconnects by itself. No terminal, no re-opening the desktop icon. That matters because some changes cannot hot-reload: - you changed a plugin's **host half**, and Node caches imported ES modules by URL; - you edited `config.json`, the port, or the workspace; - a session holds in-memory state you want gone. Today those mean walking back to a terminal. This plugin turns them into one click. ## Try it ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:chenkui-luo/dsh-plugin-restart ``` Then **refresh the page once** and open **Settings → Restart**. Without the `dsh` CLI (no pnpm, or a patched profile): copy the package into `/node_modules/dsh-plugin-restart` and add this row to `/cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - insert: - id: restart name: 'dsh-plugin-restart' ``` The bundled installer does both steps with a backup and a read-back check before it writes: ```powershell powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Install-RestartPlugin.ps1 powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Install-RestartPlugin.ps1 -Action disable powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Install-RestartPlugin.ps1 -Action uninstall ``` ## What happens when you click | Step | What runs | | --- | --- | | 1 | The page sends `POST /dsh-restart/restart` — same origin, authenticated | | 2 | The host half starts a **detached helper** and answers the request *before* anything is stopped | | 3 | The helper waits for the port to stop accepting connections, then hands over to your launcher | | 4 | The launcher starts a fresh `dsh web` with a new launch token and writes its token file | | 5 | The helper confirms the replacement is up, then lets the old process exit — gracefully | | 6 | The page sees a new instance id on its next poll and reloads itself | Nothing is force-killed in the middle of the response, and the old process is stopped **last**, by itself. A restart that fails leaves a diagnosis in the log instead of failing silently. ## Why the helper is a detached **node** process This part was measured on a real Windows machine, not assumed: | how a background helper is started | does it run | does it outlive the process it must replace | | --- | --- | --- | | PowerShell, `detached: true` | **no** — exits 0, silently | — | | PowerShell, attached | yes | no — dies with its parent | | **node, `detached: true`** | yes | **yes** | | node, attached | yes | no | On Windows a "detached" PowerShell child gets no console and never runs the script — the same trap [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) documents. An attached helper dies together with the process it is supposed to replace. So the helper is a detached node process, and it gives its own children a hidden console through `powershell -WindowStyle Hidden`. Force-killing the whole tree is the other half of the story: it leaves a Windows port unbindable long enough for the replacement to die with `EADDRINUSE`. Waiting for the port to go quiet and only then starting the replacement is what makes the handover reliable. ## Verified, not asserted | Check | Result | | --- | --- | | Helper generation, offline (`runtime-test/CheckHelperScript.mjs`) | 11/11 | | End to end, real plugin code (`runtime-test/VerifyRestartPlugin.mjs`) | 21/21 | | **Real** launcher + **real** `dsh web`, full restart cycle (`runtime-test/SmokeRestartReal.ps1`) | pass | The end-to-end runs cover: the installer writing a managed patch row, the host half claiming its routes, an unauthenticated request being fenced off, the restart being accepted before the port goes away, a second click inside the guard window being refused, the port wait, the launcher handover, the successor process appearing, and the page noticing it. These live in the toolkit this plugin was built in; this repository is the packaged plugin. ## API Every route passes the connection trust fence (loopback peer + matching `Origin` + login cookie), so only an authenticated same-origin page can reach them. | Method | Path | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | GET | `/dsh-restart/status` | `instanceId` (this server's pid), port, workspace, launcher path and availability, whether a restart is in flight | | POST | `/dsh-restart/restart` | Arms a restart. A second request within 15 s gets `409`. The response carries **no** launch token | | GET | `/dsh-restart/log` | Tail of the shared restart log | If the automatic reload comes back unauthenticated — a fresh launch token is minted on every start — the page's own token is handed back to the *same* browser connection once, so it can reopen itself with `?token=…`. ## Logs `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeekHarness\restart-plugin\logs\restart.log` — append-only, so the record of a restart survives the process that performed it. The helper writes the launcher's exit code, whether the port is still being served, and whether a fresh token file appeared, because the process that would normally log a failure is the one that just exited. ## Configuration | Variable | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `DSH_RESTART_INSTALL_DIR` | Launcher runtime directory (default `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeekHarness`) | | `DSH_RESTART_DATA` | Plugin-private data directory (default `\restart-plugin`) | | `DSH_RESTART_LAUNCHER` | Point at another launcher script (portable installs, tests) | **Restart target.** By default it delegates to the launcher a hosted install already has (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeekHarness\Launch-DeepSeekHarness.ps1`), which owns the reliable stop/start/readiness sequence. When that file is missing the button reports a clear error instead of pretending to work, and the status card shows the path it looked for. Making the plugin fully standalone is the next step on the roadmap. ## Safety - Authenticated same-origin loopback only; proxy-forwarded requests are not honoured. - No admin rights, no system configuration touched. - It **interrupts a running conversation turn** — that is what a restart is, and the card says so. - If the port is owned by a process the launcher does not recognise (a `dsh web` you started by hand), the restart takes that port over, including its terminal's process tree. ## Credits - **DeepSeek Harness (dsh)** — the open-source agent harness this plugin extends and is built on: its `dsh.bundle` + `cordis.patch.yml` declaration, the dual host/browser plugin shape, and the webserver's trust fence. [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) · MIT. - **[dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market)** — the community plugin market. Its `restart.js` is the reference for the approach used here: delegate to a detached helper, wait for the port instead of guessing with a fixed delay, and make a failed restart leave evidence. ## License MIT

plugins.description: A transparent always-on-top desktop pet for DSH on Linux (X11 / XWayland)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pet-desktop-linux

[**English**](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A desktop pet for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) on Linux: a small transparent,
always-on-top GTK3 window that floats over your desktop and animates according to
what your DSH sessions are doing — idle, working, waiting for an answer, failed,
or finished and awaiting review. It is not click-through: the window keeps its
input region, so clicks on the pet land on the pet.

**Platform: Linux with X11 or XWayland only.** Windows, macOS and native Wayland
(no XWayland) are not supported. See [Requirements](#requirements).

![The pet floating transparently over the desktop](assets/screenshots/desktop-pet-linux-1.png)

The window has no background and no border — the wallpaper shows through, and the
pet stays on top of ordinary windows. The sprite follows your DSH sessions:

![Idle, working, waiting, failed and review poses](assets/screenshots/desktop-pet-linux-2.png)

> **Canonical copy:** this plugin is only published as
> `dsh-pet-desktop-linux` (no scope) under the `Wlaeg` account. Any other
> package with this name is not ours.

---

## This is not a meta-package

This plugin ships **its own working program**; it is not a bundle that only
re-exports somebody else's dependency list:

| Part | File | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Desktop program | `desktop/pet.py` | The pet window itself: GTK3 transparent window, spritesheet animation, right-click menu, work-status dialog |
| Host half | `lib/index.js` | Probes system dependencies, spawns/stops the Python program, exposes the HTTP routes, reads and writes the config file |
| Browser half | `client.js` | The **Desktop Pet** panel in DSH Settings, with the packaged `locale/{en,zh}.json` manifest strings |

The single dependency, `@michengai/dsh-codex-pet`, is used **only to read the pet
sprite sheets**. This plugin deliberately does not copy that artwork into its own
repository: store rules require a bundle's dependencies to resolve to the original
author's published package, so this plugin depends on the upstream npm package
and resolves the artwork path at runtime
(`require.resolve('@michengai/dsh-codex-pet/package.json')`). See
[Artwork and licensing](#artwork-and-licensing).

The upstream plugin draws a pet **inside the DSH web page**. This plugin draws a
**separate always-on-top desktop window** that works while the page is in the
background, minimized, or closed. They are different things, not duplicates.

---

## Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Platform | **Linux with X11 or XWayland.** Verified on Manjaro GNOME (Wayland session, pet runs through XWayland) |
| DSH | Any DSH build with the Cordis plugin system that provides `webServer` and the `settings.section` slot |
| Node | **>= 22** (DSH's own requirement) |
| Desktop session | A GTK3-capable session. Under GNOME/Wayland the pet is an XWayland client — a **pure Wayland session with XWayland disabled will not work** |
| npm dependencies | `@michengai/dsh-codex-pet` (artwork lookup only) |

### System packages

The Settings panel probes five of these — Python 3, PyGObject, GTK3, GdkPixbuf
and `xdotool` — and shows the matching install hint for your distribution when
one is missing. The other two rows (the WebP loader and `zstd`) are not probed;
check them yourself with the commands below if the pet starts but looks wrong.

| Component | Arch / Manjaro | Debian / Ubuntu | Fedora |
|---|---|---|---|
| Python 3 | `python` | `python3` | `python3` |
| Python 3 + PyGObject (`import gi`) | `python-gobject` | `python3-gi` | `python3-gobject` |
| GTK3 typelib | `gtk3` | `gir1.2-gtk-3.0` | `gtk3` |
| GdkPixbuf typelib | `gdk-pixbuf2` | `gir1.2-gdkpixbuf-2.0` | `gdk-pixbuf2` |
| WebP loader for GdkPixbuf | *(built into `gdk-pixbuf2`)* | `webp-pixbuf-loader` | `webp-pixbuf-loader` |
| `zstd` CLI *(only if Python < 3.14)* | `zstd` | `zstd` | `zstd` |
| xdotool | `xdotool` | `xdotool` | `xdotool` |

```sh
# Arch / Manjaro
sudo pacman -S python python-gobject gtk3 gdk-pixbuf2 zstd xdotool

# Debian / Ubuntu
sudo apt install python3 python3-gi gir1.2-gtk-3.0 gir1.2-gdkpixbuf-2.0 webp-pixbuf-loader zstd xdotool

# Fedora
sudo dnf install python3 python3-gobject gtk3 gdk-pixbuf2 webp-pixbuf-loader zstd xdotool
```

The session event files are zstd-compressed. Python 3.14 and newer decode them
with the standard library (`compression.zstd`); on older interpreters the plugin
falls back to the `zstd` command-line tool, so install `zstd` if your `python3`
is older than 3.14. Without either, the pet still runs but never leaves `idle`.

The sprite sheets are WebP files, so GdkPixbuf must be able to decode WebP.
Depending on your distribution's GdkPixbuf version this may need the separate
`webp-pixbuf-loader` package (Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora). You can check yours with
the command below; if it prints `False`, install the loader package:

```sh
python3 -c "import gi; gi.require_version('GdkPixbuf','2.0'); \
from gi.repository import GdkPixbuf; \
print('webp' in [f.get_name() for f in GdkPixbuf.Pixbuf.get_formats()])"
```

The plugin's dependency probe checks GTK3, GdkPixbuf and `xdotool` by name but
does not decode a WebP sprite itself; if the loader is missing, the pet window
appears and the sprite fails to load, which shows up in the log tail.

`xdotool` is used for the two EWMH window hints GTK3 cannot set by itself:
`_NET_WM_STATE_ABOVE` (keep above) and `_NET_WM_STATE_STICKY` (show on every
workspace). Without it the pet still appears, but it will not stay on top of
other windows or follow you across workspaces.

Decoding goes through `GdkPixbuf.PixbufLoader` and frames are drawn as
`Gtk.Image` pixbufs, so **Pillow is not needed**, and because no drawing goes
through a `cairo.Context`, **pycairo is not needed either**.

---

## Installation

This is a DSH Cordis plugin **bundle**. Install it through DSH's plugin manager
(`plugin_manager`, action `install_bundle`), pointing `target` at either:

- the **Git repository** — `https://github.com/Wlaeg/dsh-pet-desktop-linux`
- or a **local checkout** — the absolute path to this directory

Equivalently, from a DSH shell:

```sh
# once published to npm
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pet-desktop-linux

# straight from the repository
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Wlaeg/dsh-pet-desktop-linux

# from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-pet-desktop-linux
```

The bundle declares its own patch in `package.json`:

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" },
    "client": {
      "platform": "web",
      "immediately": true,
      "inject": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer"]
    }
  },
  "icon": "./assets/icon.png"
}
```

(`dsh.client.inject` is a client-module **load-order** declaration: DSH loads the
listed packages' browser bundles before this one. It is not Cordis service
injection. The browser half declares the services it actually needs itself:
`return { inject: ['slots', 'locale'], apply }`.)

and that patch is a single `insert` that mounts the host half:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-pet-desktop-linux
      name: 'dsh-pet-desktop-linux'
      config: {}
```

The browser half is declared by `dsh.client` and bound to the row whose `name` is
the bare package name — subpath rows do not carry a browser half.

After installing, reload the DSH Web UI page so the browser half registers its
Settings panel. Nothing else is required: **DSH starts the pet window by itself**
as soon as it boots (`autostart` defaults to `true` — see “Configuration”). The
pet process stops when you stop it or uninstall the bundle.

> Replacing an already-installed copy (for example after editing the source)
> needs a restart of the DSH host process — the running process keeps the JS
> module generation it loaded at startup. A page reload is not enough.

---

## Features

**Window**

- Borderless, transparent GTK3 window — only the pet is visible, the window
  background is fully transparent
- Always on top (`_NET_WM_STATE_ABOVE`), so it stays above normal windows
- Sticky across workspaces (`_NET_WM_STATE_STICKY`, via `xdotool`) — no API for
  this exists in GT

plugins.description: DSH 助手人格与长期记忆插件：独立可用，不依赖其它插件。管 AI 自身的名字与角色、对用户的称呼、回复风格与自定义指令；人设支持全局 + 按工作区两级覆盖；长期记忆走三段式（候选捕获 → 待审缓冲区 → 用户裁决才生效），并支持一键导入其它 AI 的历史记忆。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-anima

DSH 的**助手人格与外挂记忆层**——一个独立插件，装上即可用。

它管的是「**你自己（助手）是谁**」：AI 的名字与角色、你对它的称呼、回复风格、
以及你自己写的行为准则；再加一套**带待审缓冲区的长期记忆**，
以及输入框光轨、输入框快捷开关、工具确认门槛这些界面能力。
字段集不依赖任何其它插件，也不从别处读取配置。

> **工具名为什么是 `set_assistant_persona`**：`tools.register()` 遇同层重名直接抛错
> （`dsh-tools/lib/index.js:2634`），与生态里任何同名工具共存时必有一方注册失败、
> 被 `.catch` 吞成一行 warn —— 那是发布级的静默故障。功能相似不要求撞名。

---

## 它解决什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **AI 自己的名字与角色** | `agentName` / `agentRole` —— 决定它怎么称呼自己、以什么身份说话 |
| 用户的称呼 / 背景 / 语气 / 长度 / 语言 | `addressUserAs` / `userOccupation` / `userBio` / `style` / `replyLength` / `language` |
| **按工作区两层覆盖** | 只覆盖声明的字段，其余继承全局；覆盖文件随目录走、可 git |
| **长期记忆** | 自动沉淀 → 待审缓冲区 → 用户裁决 → 注入 |
| 输入框光轨 / 快捷开关 / 工具确认 | 界面与安全开关 |
| 人设预设 | 6 条内置 + 自建；也可把当前配置存成预设 |
| **十二个字段全是自由文本** | 存的就是注入的原话，另有「一键填入 + 示例」按钮组 |
| **记忆随工作区分层** | 全局记忆处处生效，工作区记忆只在匹配时注入 |
| **注入可解释 / 字符预算** | 每条为什么进 / 不进，条数与字符双约束 |
| **本地聚类与冲突提示** | 纯本地 bigram 相似度，只提示不自动合并 |
| **人设变更审计日志** | 谁在什么时候把哪个字段改成什么 |
| **一键导入外部 AI 的记忆** | 复制提示词 → 粘贴结果 → 机械切分 → 逐条裁决层级 |
| 长期记忆的「自动写入」 | ❌ 刻意不做（见下） |

### 关于与 `dsh-soul` 的关系

上表左侧的能力划分与 `dsh-soul` 0.7.0 的字段集**有交集**，实现上也刻意与它保持一致
（工具确认语义、光轨动效参数、重置保留预设）。但本插件**不依赖它**：
字段集完整自持，不读它的配置文件，两者可同时安装且标识全部错开。
这层关系的完整说明见下方「[致谢与差异化声明](#致谢与差异化声明)」。

## 四个差异化设计

功能对齐不等于没有自己的判断。以下四点是本插件相对主流记忆插件的**真实增量**，
每一条都对应一个具体的失败模式。

### 1. 双约束注入：条数与字符同时生效

多数实现只有一个「最多注入 N 条」的上限。问题是 40 条长记忆一样能挤爆上下文，
而用户看到的是「我只设了 40 条啊」。

本插件的 `selectForInjection` 同时受 `memory.maxInjected`（条数，默认 40）与
`memory.maxInjectedChars`（字符，默认 4000）约束，**取先到者**。两条上限各有各的适用场景：
条数管「别让模型看太多碎片」，字符管「别让一次注入吃掉半屏上下文」。

### 2. 注入可解释：看得见每条为什么进 / 不进

注入不是黑箱。设置页的「注入情况」列出**每一条已采纳记忆**的去留与原因：

| 原因码 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `included` | 已注入提示词 |
| `other-workspace` | 属于别的工作区，不在本会话注入 |
| `no-workspace-context` | 当前会话没有工作区信息，无法匹配工作区记忆 |
| `workspace-scope-unknown` | 标记为工作区记忆但没记录属于哪个工作区 |
| `over-max` | 已采纳条数超过注入上限，按时间取最新的 |
| `over-budget` | 单条就超出字符预算，取不下 |
| `dropped-by-budget` | 前面几条已占满字符预算 |
| `no-injection` | 记忆层已关闭或上限为 0 |

区分 `over-budget` 与 `dropped-by-budget` 是刻意的：前者要删那条，后者要腾位置 ——
报同一个码，用户不知道该动谁。原因文案由宿主下发（`INJECTION_REASON_TEXT` 只有一份），
客户端不重写翻译。

### 3. 本地聚类：只提示，不自动合并

待审缓冲区里若有多条明显在说同一件事，插件用**字符二元组（bigram）的 Jaccard 系数**
（纯本地、零依赖、零模型调用）算出相似度，把「这 3 条像在说同一件事」摆到用户面前。

**刻意不做自动合并**：合并意味着生成一段用户没说过的话。本插件的立场是
「判断什么值得记交给模型，什么真的生效交给用户」——自动合并恰好违背它。
聚类只让裁决更快，不替他裁决。同理「候选撞上已采纳记忆」只提示冲突，不改任何数据。

### 4. 人设变更审计日志

本插件有三个入口能改人设：设置页、`/anima` 命令、模型调用的 `set_assistant_persona` 工具。
而「工具确认」**默认是关的** —— 也就是说，模型可以直接把你叫它什么、它用什么语气回话改掉，
而你无从知道是谁在什么时候干的。

审计日志只记「改了什么」，不做判断、不参与提示词。它挂在 `StateStore.updateConfig` 这**一个**
收口上，而不是在各调用点分别埋点：所有写入路径最终都走这里，分散埋点迟早会漏掉一条，
而漏掉的那条恰恰可能是模型的静默改写。`resetConfig` 也走审计 —— 否则
「昨天还好好的，今天全空了」在日志里查无此事。

记录上限 200 条，独立成表（不塞进 `config`）：`config` 每次启动整条读入内存，
审计会涨到几百条，混在一起等于让启动开销随使用时长上升。
长值在写入时截断为 200 字并附「共 N 字」，数组/对象只记规模 —— 审计是索引，不是备份。

看到它的地方有两处：设置页「变更记录」卡（完整列表，可按条清空），
以及 `/anima show` 的**「最近变更」一行**——只显示最新那条，格式是
`[MM-DD HH:mm] <来源>：<字段名>`，**刻意不带具体值**：值可能很私人，而 `show`
的输出会被复制到对话里问人。

## 致谢与差异化声明

本插件的功能集**参考**了 [dsh-soul](https://github.com/Aliuyanfeng/dsh-soul)（MIT）与
`dsh-checkpoint-rewind` 的设计，并在若干处刻意与它们保持行为一致（存储惰性解析、
失败关闭的确认语义、重置保留用户预设、光轨动效参数）。

需要明确的是：

- **代码全部独立实现**，未拷贝上述项目的源码、注释、提示词文案或图形资源。
- 两处**动效参数刻意取同值**（8 层错位描边、虚线段长 12 / 步进 2.2 / 圆角 22 等），
  理由是避免同一台机器上出现两套观感。这类数值属于思想与参数，不受著作权保护；
  记在这里是为了不让读者误以为拷贝。
- **导航图标刻意画得不同形**：dsh-soul 用「光轨弧 + 火花」，本插件用「人像（头+肩）+ 火花」，
  单色 `currentColor`，viewBox 也另行收紧。
- **各类标识全部错开**，避免共存时互相顶替或注册失败：

  | 类别 | dsh-soul | 本插件 |
  |---|---|---|
  | 工具名 | `set_persona` | `set_assistant_persona` |
  | 设置页 id | `soul-settings` | `anima-settings` |
  | 光轨槽位 id | `soul-trail` | `anima-trail` |
  | 开关槽位 id | `soul-quick-toggle` | `anima-quick-toggle` |
  | 提示词 section | `soul:persona` | `anima:identity` / `:memory` / `:pending` |
  | 存储域 | —（自有文件） | `anima` |
  | 注入来源 kind | `plugin:dsh-soul` | `plugin:dsh-anima` |

工具名错开不只是礼貌：`dsh-tools` 的 `register()` 遇同层重名**直接抛错**
（`lib/index.js` 的 `NamedEntries` 冲突工厂），两者共存时必有一方注册失败、
并被 `.catch` 吞成一行 warn —— 那是发布级的静默故障。



## 核心设计：三段式记忆

这是本插件与市面上 15+ 记忆插件最不一样的地方。

```
对话中通过 remember 工具投递
        ↓
   待审缓冲区（不生效）
        ↓  每晚自动整理：去重 / 淘汰 / 与已采纳项比对
        ↓
   通知用户「有 N 条待你裁决」
        ↓
   用户在设置页逐个「采纳 / 丢弃 / 删除」
        ↓
   已采纳 → 注入提示词
```

**为什么不做静默自动写入**：记忆一旦静默写入就直接影响后续所有回答，写错了用户很难发现。
本插件把「判断什么值得记」交给模型，把「什么真的生效」交给用户。

整理这一步**纯本地、不调用模型**——只做去重、淘汰、与已采纳项比对，不做语义归纳。

记忆**分两层**：`global` 处处生效，`workspace` 只在 `cwd` 归一化后完全相等时注入。
不做「子目录继承」——工作区覆盖是精确匹配语义，记忆若采用继承语义，
用户在子目录里会看到父目录的记忆，排查起来极难。
分层之外的注入解释、预算与聚类见上文「四个差异化设计」。

## 凭据闸门

任何命中凭据形态的内容**在进入缓冲区之前就被拒收**（不落盘、不留痕），
覆盖私钥块、OpenAI/AWS/GitHub 令牌、通用 api_key / secret / 密码赋值、Bearer、
URL 内嵌凭据等 11 类模式。

理由：内容一旦落盘缓冲区，就处于「等待进入提示词」的状态，凭据不该走这条路。
凭据判定用的是 11 类正则的机械匹配，没有语义理解，会有误判——所以被拦下时界面会
把命中规则名一起说出来，用户可以删掉那串字符再粘贴。

## 一键导入外部 AI 的记忆

设置页记忆卡里有一个「导入外部 AI 的记忆」按钮，展开后是两步：

1. **复制提示词**——把一段整理画像的提示词发给你用得最多的那个 AI，让它把你的偏好
   整理成清单。按钮只在真的写进剪贴板后才显示「已复制」；没有剪贴板 API 时会明说
   「复制失败，请手动选中后复制」，不假装成功。
2. **粘贴结果**——粘贴框接受 AI 的输出，也接受你自己手写的笔记（不要求必须是 AI 生成的）。

解析后逐条预览，每条都能改层级（全局 / 本工作区）或直接丢弃，确认后才写进**待审缓冲区**
——和手动添加、模型投递走同一条路，仍然要用户逐条裁决才生效。

**切分是机械的，不做语义理解**：按 Markdown 标题、列表项、空行三种边界切；刻意不按句号切，
因为中文画像里「偏好：结论先行。」被切成两条会读不通。小节标签（如「我的使用画像」）
不进候选——它长得像记忆但没有可采纳内容。

**归类是建议不是判决**：`suggestLayer` 只看措辞——提到具体磁盘路径或「本项目 / 这个项目」
建议 `workspace`，提到「所有项目 / 一律 / 每次都要」建议 `global`。两条都没有时默认 `global`，
理由是把「记忆动不动就不生效」当默认体验，比跨项目污染更糟。每条建议都带一句理由显示在
条目下方，用户看到「本工作区」就能立刻知道凭什么。

**解析阶段就分流**：一条原文切完后按顺序过五道闸，没通过的会被分别归到不同的桶里，
每一桶都在界面上显示出来，**不静默少一条**：

| 处置 | 判定 | 界面上 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 过短（`< 4` 信息量） | 切出的碎片太短，通常是编号残留 | 只在汇总里报个数 |
| 超长（`> 500` 字） | 单条超过记忆上限 | 不截断，明确告知「请拆成几条」 |
| 凭据 | 命中 11 类正则之一 | 整条拦下并说明命中了哪条规则 |
| 重复 | 与已有记忆文本相同 | 单独列出 |
| 超条数 | 超出单次上限（默认 60 条） | 余下部分不进这一批，另开一次导入 |
| 同义 | 与待审缓冲区里的某条相似度 ≥ 0.6 | 在条目下方提示「已有一条很像」，**不自动合并** |

原文上限 40000 字符，超出直接报错而不是截断（截断等于偷偷丢掉用户画像的后半段）。
同义提示刻意只提示不合并：自动合并会生成一段用户从没说过的话。

---

## 安装

### 从 GitHub 安装（推荐）

本插件尚未发布到 npm，从仓库直接装：

```
dsh plugin add github:Melody-cx/dsh-anima#v1.0.0
```

或者手工改 profile 的 `package.json`：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-anima": "github:Melody-cx/dsh-anima#v1.0.0"
  },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ /* ... */ "dsh-anima" ] } }
}
```

`#v1.0.0` 是标签（也可以写 commit SHA，或整个省略以跟随 `main`）。**建议 pin 住一个版本**，
否则上游的任何改动都会在下次安装时直接进入你的 profile。git 源下载的是**整个仓库 tarball**
（本仓库很小），首次安装可能比 npm 源慢一些，超时的话重试一次即可。

然后 `pnpm install`，**重启 DSH**。宿主侧改动一律需要重启才生效。

### 从源码安装（开发用）

在 profile 的 `package.json` 里加依赖（也可以用 `/plugins` 界面）：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-anima": "file:<仓库目录的绝对路径>"
  },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ /* ... */ "dsh-anima" ] } }
}
```

本地 `file:` 依赖是**复制**语义：改完源码要**重新安装**才生效，且重跑安装时若 pnpm 判定
`changed:false` 会直接跳过 —— 正确姿势是先 `remove_bundle` 再 `install_bundle`
（或比对 `node_modules` 副本与源码的 SHA256）。

**运行前提**（`package.json` 里已声明，装不上时先看这几条）：

- `engines.node` = `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`，`engines.dsh` = `>=0.1.6-0 <0.2.0 || >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0-0`
- `peerDependencies` 四包：`@deepseek-ai/cordis`（`^4.0.1 || ^4.0.5-alpha.1`）、
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`
  —— 它们由宿主提供，插件不打包它们
- `dependencies.zod`（`^4.4.3`）是唯一真正要装的运行时依赖
- 存储栈需在 profile 里组合：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json`（配 `root`）
  + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain`（配 `backend: json`）。缺了不会崩，但插件会退化成
  「存储不可用」，设置页会明说原因（见下「存储」一节）

## 配置

设置页新增一栏「**灵台**」（`settings.section` id = `anima-settings`，order 51）。

- **助手身份**：`enabled` / `agentName` / `agentRole` / `addressUserAs` / `userOccupation` / `userBio`
- **回复风格**：`style` / `headingLists` / `emoji` / `tables` / `replyLength` / `language` / `customInstructions`
- **工作区覆盖**：`workspaceOverridesEnabled` / `workspaceFileDir`
  覆盖文件默认写在 `<工作区>/.dsh-anima/override.json`（目录名可用 `workspaceFileDir` 改），随目录走、可 git、可拷给别人；
  该目录会自动写入 `.gitignore`（内容 `*`），避免私人语气设定被推到远程。
- **输入框光轨**：`trailEnabled` / `trailColor`（`#RRGGBB`，落盘统一大写）/ `trailSpeed`（`slow|normal|fast`）/ `trailWidth`（`thin|normal|thick`）
- **工具确认**：`requireToolConfirmation` —— 开启后模型调 `set_assistant_persona` 只**提交提议**，不写配置
- **长期记忆**：`memory.enabled` / `autoCapture` / `nightlyTriage` / `nightlyHour` / `maxPending` /
  `maxInjected` / `maxInjectedChars` / `notifyOnSessionStart` / `defaultLayer`

### 不做任何迁移

本插件**不读任何其它插件或自己旧版本的配置**。它是 1.0.0，此前没有发布过任何版本 ——
没有「老用户的介质」这种东西需要兼容，所以代码里既没有一次性迁移，也没有存储格式回退。
这两块曾存在于开发期，都已删除；留着它们的唯一作用是让后人以为有一批需要照顾的存

plugins.description: 给 DSH 里助手回复加气泡底，可选液态玻璃材质；工具条、过程行、统计行等周边信息也能一起同步
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-assistant-bubble [![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) 使用皮肤插件从wallpaper里导入深色壁纸时，会发现ai回复的文字是无背景的，导致字和壁纸糊在一起无法阅读。所以让大肥鱼单独写了一个小插件实现气泡功能。 这下可以愉快地使用壁纸了。 . 有一些气泡间距的小问题，可能对观感有小影响，但是不太好修，所以就放在那里了， 插件开启前 开启后。气泡透明度之类的可以自己调，单独在设置里开了“助手回复气泡”的分区页。 ————以下内容都是肥鱼写的 给 DSH 里**助手回复**加一层自己的气泡底，可选液态玻璃材质；工具条、过程行、统计行等周边信息也能一起同步。 ## 为什么需要它 DSH 官方会话界面里，气泡（`..._bubble`）只属于**你发送的消息**；助手回复是一段**没有背景**的正文， 直接压在壁纸上。所以壁纸 / 皮肤类插件的"气泡不透明度""玻璃透明度"都管不到助手回复 —— 深色壁纸下助手的字就看不清了。这个插件补的就是这一块。 ## 功能 - **助手回复气泡**：圆角 + 可调底色；可选液态玻璃（白釉高光 + 模糊 + 厚玻璃折射 + 落地阴影）。 - **周边信息同步**：工具条（复制 / 点赞 / 分享 / 用量 / 时间）、过程折叠行、过程分组头（运行中）、 思考触发条、会话统计行、上下文占用环、运行行 —— 同一份材质、同一组参数，滑块一动一起变。 - **只给"真的有内容"的元素画底**：每个锚点都先核对有没有看得见的文字（≥2 个字）或可见的按钮 / 图标， 空壳一律不画 —— 所以不会出现"只有底色、没有文字"的空白气泡。 - **「工作步骤展示」明细行**：工具调用行（「运行命令」「网页获取」等）与「思考」行也有气泡 —— **折叠**时是紧凑小胶囊、**展开**时保持宿主原本的大横条。 - **操作条常驻**：取消宿主"非最后一条要悬停才显示"的门控。 - **宽度跟随内容**：气泡不拉满整行。 - **宽表格收进气泡**：宿主原本让宽表格按滚动容器整屏出血，这里改为气泡内横向滚动。 - **无障碍**：系统开启「减少透明度」时自动去掉模糊与白釉。 ## 安装 ```bash # 从 GitHub 安装（最新 main） dsh plugin --profile web add github:yutianliang/dsh-assistant-bubble ``` 官方桌面端也可以走侧边栏 **插件** 页 → 添加插件 → 填 `github:yutianliang/dsh-assistant-bubble`。 本地改代码时用 `link:`：`dsh plugin --profile web add link:E:\path\to\dsh-assistant-bubble`。 卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-assistant-bubble`。 ## 设置 安装后，**设置 →「助手回复气泡」**（独立分区，10 个控件）： | 控件 | 作用 | 默认 | | --- | --- | --- | | 液态玻璃 | 白釉高光 + 模糊 + 厚玻璃折射；关掉 = 平实心气泡 | 开 | | 周边信息同步 | 上面那七处周边信息是否同材质 | 开 | | 气泡不透明度 | 关闭液态玻璃时的底色浓度 | 60% | | 玻璃底色浓度 | 玻璃挡下的底色浓度，越高越不透 | 50% | | 雾化 | 玻璃的模糊半径 | 3px | | 玻璃颜色 | 6 个预设色块 + 取色器自定义 | #ffffff（深色 #12141a） | | 白釉强度 | 表面高光与边缘折射强度，0–200% | 100% | | 深色单独设置 | 打开后深色主题用另一套上面四项 | 关 | 值保存在浏览器本地 `localStorage["dsh-assistant-bubble:settings"]`（清缓存会回默认值）。 ## 兼容性 - **不声明 `engines` / `peerDependencies`**：安装与启用不会被版本检查拦下。 - 客户端半区**不声明** `dsh.client.inject`：模块无条件加载，气泡样式一定生效； `slots` / `locale` 两个服务用 `ctx.inject` 运行时等待，拿不到只丢设置页。 - 唯一外部依赖是宿主写在 DOM 上的语义属性与 CSS-Module 类名后缀。宿主大版本更新后最坏的情况是 **样式静默失效**（看起来像没装），不会报错、不会牵连其它插件。 ## 实现要点 所有参数走 CSS 变量，设置页把值内联写到 `body` 上： ``` --dab-solid-alpha 实心气泡底浓度 --dab-glass-alpha 玻璃挡底浓度 --dab-glass-color 玻璃色（r, g, b） --dab-blur 雾化半径 --dab-sheen 白釉强度倍数 ``` 玻璃配方对齐 [`dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine`](https://github.com/elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine) 的玻璃面： 白釉渐变 + `blur() saturate(1.3) brightness(1.04)` + 双向内阴影折射 + 落地阴影。 ### 思考面板的标题行 展开「思考」时，宿主会给面板内部的**粘性标题行**铺一层实心底色（`--dsw-alias-bg-base`，深色主题下近黑， 展开后就是压在内容上的一条黑带）。这里把它换成**同一颜色的半透明版**并保留吸顶： ```css background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dsw-alias-bg-base) 80%, transparent) ``` 滚到顶部时仍能遮住下方内容，但不再是一条实心黑条。（不用 `backdrop-filter`：那会把下方的浅色文字 糊成一条白带。） ### 挂在哪些锚点上 | 位置 | 锚点 | | --- | --- | | 助手回复正文 | `[data-chat-flow-kind="assistant-step"] div[class*="_root"] > div[class*="_body"]` | | 工具条（复制 / 点赞 / 用量 / 时间） | `[data-turn-tail] [class*="_actions"]` | | 过程折叠行「已完成，用时 N 秒」 | `[data-turn-process]` | | 过程分组头「正在分析请求 · ⋯」 | `[data-process-activity]` | | 思考触发条 | `[data-turn-trigger]` | | 工具调用行（运行命令 / 网页获取…） | `[data-tool] [data-disclosure-row]` | | 「思考」行 | `[data-variant="think"] [data-disclosure-row]` | | 会话统计行「N 轮 M 步 · tok/s」 | `[data-composer-stats]` | | 上下文占用环「41%」 | `button[class*="_trigger"]:has(> svg[viewBox="0 0 14 14"])` | | 运行行「深度求索中⋯」 | `[data-chat-running]` | | 宽表格 | `.md-table-wide` | ## 开发 实现细节、设计取舍与踩过的坑见 [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)。 ## License MIT
